instruction: Hand over in one breath: the next song's title and its artist, and nothing else.
Say what just played and how it landed, in a sentence or two, then name the next song and its artist. No facts this time.
Start with a short aside that is not about the songs: the time of day, the station, or what people asked us for. Then bring in the next song with its title and artist.
Set up the next song: its album, its year, its tags, what to listen for. Name the title and the artist at the end, as the hand-over.
Tell something true about the next artist or song, taken from the facts below and told in your own words, like a short story. Then bring the song in with its title and artist.
